title: The price stops at the doorstep
request: It is 2026-10-28 at 09:15 UTC. I need this used drill delivered for flatpack assembly. My hard limit is 1,000 SEK including every mandatory charge; I cannot collect it. Does the supplied offer fit? I own suitable bits. Use only the supplied evidence.

evidence.text: Synthetic listing; Northbank is fictional. D18 kit includes the drill, A18-2 battery and C18-A charger. Item price: 899.95 SEK. Seller says it works and can be shipped, but has not quoted delivery. Buyer may also collect for free. No measured battery runtime is supplied.

Synthetic transaction terms: a mandatory buyer fee of 50.10 SEK applies to this offer. Delivery is separate. There are no other mandatory charges. No delivery amount is available in the supplied record.
Synthetic exact-model reference: D18 supports ordinary flatpack screw driving with the buyer's bits, accepts A18-2 batteries and uses C18-A charging.

hard_failures.text: States that the delivered offer is confirmed within budget despite the missing delivery amount.
Invents or assumes free delivery, ignores the mandatory fee, or treats free collection as satisfying the buyer's delivery requirement.

usefulness.text: States the known subtotal of 950.05 SEK and identifies delivery as the remaining unknown cost.
Explains that delivery must be at most 49.95 SEK to meet the 1,000 SEK inclusive limit.
Makes obtaining a delivery quote the decisive next step without asking again whether collection is possible.

acceptable_outcomes: Potential fit, but the delivered budget is unverified until a delivery quote of 49.95 SEK or less is supplied.
A conditional recommendation is acceptable; a definite under-budget recommendation is not.
